project.description: 수동 실행 전용. 격리 MSA에서 두 폐기 동시 재시도 시나리오와 조회 전용 OpenCode A2A를 검증한다.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/sh set +x set -eu umask 077 export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
: "${WORKSPACE:?Jenkins workspace required}" artifacts="$WORKSPACE/artifacts" report="$artifacts/disposal-concurrent-retries.json" test ! -L "$artifacts" mkdir -p "$artifacts" rm -f "$report"
: "${ERPMSA_DISPOSAL_REPO:?Configure the prepared ErpMSA checkout on the node}" : "${ERPMSA_DISPOSAL_BACKUP:?Configure the read-only legacy backup path on the node}" : "${ERPMSA_DISPOSAL_MIGRATION_REPORT:?Configure the migration report path on the node}"
cd "$ERPMSA_DISPOSAL_REPO" exec python3 scripts/verify-disposal-concurrent-retries.py \ --backup "$ERPMSA_DISPOSAL_BACKUP" \ --migration-report "$ERPMSA_DISPOSAL_MIGRATION_REPORT" \ --mysql-bin-dir "${ERPMSA_DISPOSAL_MYSQL_BIN_DIR:-/usr/local/mysql/bin}" \ --prometheus "${ERPMSA_DISPOSAL_PROMETHEUS:-prometheus}" \ --model "${ERPMSA_DISPOSAL_MODEL:-opencode/gpt-5.4-nano}" \ --report "$report"
